title: Aureline M5 build-lane descriptor
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for the contributor / PR and protected-merge build lanes. Names the allowed remote-cache trust posture, the publication authority, the controlled credential boundary, and the exact-build expectation of a lane so a contributor lane may read shared caches but never publish release artifacts and a protected-merge lane uses controlled credentials and verified caches with a missing digest blocking promotion. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, admin, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's cache and publication posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
